The '''''Silver Star''''' was a [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was the site of a meeting between an [[Unidentified Alliance ambassador|ambassador]] representing the [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|provision government]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and the [[Gaddrian ambassador]]. The [[Gaddrian ambassador]] wanted to meet with an Alliance representative to discuss the possibility of building a fifth column within the ranks of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="Luxury" />
